The '''1988 Supercopa de España''' was two-leg [[Football in Spain|Spanish]] [[association football|football]] matches played on 21 September and 29 September 1988. It contested by Barcelona, who were Spanish Cup winners in 1987–88, and Real Madrid, who won the [[1987–88 La Liga|1987–88]] Spanish League. Real Madrid won 3&ndash;2 on aggregate.
